result.summary: The pedestrian environment is poorly maintained, featuring a sidewalk significantly obstructed by debris and a lack of marked crosswalks at the intersection. hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: The roadway surface is cracked and uneven, creating potential trip hazards and poor traction.

interventions.description: Remove the debris obstructing the walkway and repair the sidewalk surface to ensure a continuous, accessible path.
